title: Dippin model catalog
description: The dippin-lang model/pricing/capability catalog. Published verbatim from the embedded pricing/prices.json at https://dippin.org/prices.json and https://dippin.org/models.json. Prices are per 1M tokens in USD, verified against official provider pages; capability/context fields are optional and absent means unknown (never a claim of zero).

provider_aliases.description: Alternate provider spellings mapped to their canonical provider name (e.g. xai -> grok).

model.description: Model identifier. Dotted and dashed forms are equivalent.

aliases.description: Alternate model spellings that resolve to this entry.

cached_input_per_m.description: Absolute cached-input price, USD per 1M tokens.

cache_read_mult.description: Cache-read rate as a fraction of the input rate. 1 = verified no discount; absent/0 = unverified (consumer may overlay).

cache_write_mult.description: Cache-write rate as a fraction of the input rate.

deprecated.description: true = retired on the first-party API but still billed on passthrough platforms.

family.description: Family within the provider, e.g. 'opus'. Enables family-reference resolution.

rank.description: Ordering within the family; higher = newer.

maturity.description: Release maturity; preview models are excluded from family-reference resolution.

context_window.description: Maximum input context window, in tokens.

capabilities.description: Supported capabilities: tool/function use, image input, and a reasoning/extended-thinking mode.

source.description: Official provider page the values were read from.

as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD the values were last verified against source.
